messages:
marie: Quick ask — can someone run a focused cross-model bench for API feature overhead? Need numbers for streaming vs sync, funcalls, and structured-output (jsonschema) across a couple model variants. Goal: actionable p50/p95 deltas for Friday product review.

rahul: I can run small jobs tonight. Which exact models, seq lengths, and metrics we care about? p50/p95 token-latency + throughput?

sasha: Metrics: p50/p95 per-token latency, end-to-end request latency, and tokens/sec. If you can grab GPU util / host CPU when available that helps root-cause.

marie: Thanks — list: rwk-13B (fp16), rwk-13B-q4, rwk-7B (fp16), open-7B. Seq lens: 128 and 1024. For funcalls run with 3 tiny tool calls (10-token outputs). For structured: include JSON schema validation step (client-side) to show validation overhead. Samples: 1000 each where feasible.

sasha: Do we have a canonical bench harness? bench-bot suggests using the run command below.

marie: Paste the snippet and we'll use that.

rahul: ```bash
bench run --suite api-overhead \
  --models rwk-13B,rwk-13B-q4,rwk-7B,open-7B \
  --seq-lens 128,1024 \
  --modes streaming,sync \
  --features funcall,structured \
  --samples 1000 \
  --output /tmp/bench-$(date +%s).json
```

bot-bench: queued job id 9922. Estimated runtime ~4h per model/seq combo. :hourglass_flowing_sand:

tomas: Heads-up: rwk-13B at 1024 (streaming) historically takes ~6min per run on our single-GPU nodes. We might need to reduce samples to 200 for that config to keep the full sweep tonight.

rahul: Ok — I'll do 200 for 13B@1024, 1000 for the rest. Will collect perf counters and traces and post partial results here.

marie: :thumbsup: Please include the exact bench config JSON and raw outputs. Tag @sre if you see regressions >10% vs baseline.

rahul: Starting run now, pinging if anything fails.

(4h later)

rahul: Partial update: rwk-7B shows small diff between sync vs streaming (~5% p95). Funcall adds ~18% overhead on p50 for streaming paths (surprising). Structured validation adds ~8% CPU overhead on the client side.

sasha: Can you paste the p95 values for 1024? Need numbers for the doc.

rahul: rwk-13B (1024): streaming p95 = 420ms/token, sync p95 = 480ms/token; funcall (streaming) p95 = 560ms/token; structured p95 = 460ms/token.

marie: That's larger-than-expected for funcall. @eng-runtime team — can someone triage? Likely suspects: extra serialization, tokenization passes, or extra RPC hops serializing tool outputs. @rahul please attach GPU/CPU traces and a flamegraph when you have them.

rahul: Uploaded summary gist: https://gist.github.com/bench-9922-summary and traces at /shared/bench/9922/. Included flame graphs and the bench config.

tomas: I'll take a look tomorrow AM. My first guess is JSON serialization + validation loop in the post-processing path causing blocking on the CPU while the GPU stalls. Also check the tokenizer double-run in the funcall code path.

marie: Good. If anyone sees >15% regression vs last-month baseline, open a perf ticket and assign to eng-runtime. I'll consolidate the results into a short slide for Friday. Thanks all.

rahul: Noted — will file tickets if we cross thresholds. Posting final artifacts here when the sweep completes.
